core: Intraflagellar transport and cilium length control
qualifier: core IFT without basal body docking or centrosome duplication
name: Intraflagellar transport and ciliary length regulation
rationale: All members concern anterograde/retrograde IFT and the balance of cilium assembly, disassembly and centriole elongation; unlike its superset neighbour it lacks basal body anchoring, transition zone and centrosome duplication terms.

qualifier: basal body docking and centrosome duplication
name: Intraflagellar transport, basal body docking and centrosome duplication
rationale: Members cover IFT and cilium assembly/disassembly control plus basal body anchoring, transition-zone targeting and centrosome duplication, which the core IFT theme lacks.

name: Copper, manganese, heme and transferrin transport
rationale: All members concern cellular transport and handling of copper, manganese, cobalt, heme and transferrin-bound iron (incl. ferroportin/DMT1/ceruloplasmin defects); it lacks the iron import, iron response and systemic iron homeostasis terms of its superset.

qualifier: iron uptake and systemic iron homeostasis
name: Iron uptake and systemic homeostasis with copper-manganese-heme transport
rationale: Members span copper, manganese, heme and transferrin transport plus iron import, cellular iron response and organismal iron homeostasis, the iron-specific block that distinguishes it from the smaller metal-transport theme.

core: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubule shaping
name: Kinesin neuronal cargo transport and ER tubule shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin/microtubule transport of mitochondria, synaptic and dense-core vesicles and receptors in axons/dendrites plus ER tubular network formation; it lacks the organelle tethering and ER positioning terms of its superset.

core: Microtubule organelle transport and ER tubule shaping
qualifier: organelle positioning and membrane contact tethering
name: Organelle transport, ER tubule shaping and inter-organelle tethering
rationale: Members combine kinesin-driven neuronal cargo transport and ER tubular network shaping with ER localization, ER-plasma membrane and mitochondria-ER tethering and autophagosome docking, which the smaller theme lacks.

core: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
name: LXR-driven lipogenesis and triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: All members concern LXR (NR1H2/3) control of lipogenesis, adipose lipolysis, triglyceride synthesis and fatty acid/triglyceride homeostasis; it lacks the gluconeogenic, adipose development and caloric restriction terms of its superset.

qualifier: gluconeogenesis, adipose development and caloric restriction
name: LXR control of triglyceride, gluconeogenic and adipose energy balance
rationale: Members cover LXR-regulated lipogenesis, lipolysis and triglyceride homeostasis plus LXR gluconeogenic genes, adipose tissue development and response to caloric restriction, which distinguish it from the lipogenesis-only theme.

qualifier: reverse cholesterol transport and sterol homeostasis
name: Reverse cholesterol transport, HDL assembly and cellular sterol homeostasis
rationale: Members span LXR/ABCA1-driven efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell control plus reverse cholesterol transport, HDL clearance, cholesterol endocytosis and biosynthesis feedback, which the smaller macrophage theme lacks.

qualifier: cholesterol loading and foam cell control
name: Macrophage cholesterol loading, foam cell control and HDL assembly
rationale: All members concern macrophage cholesterol import/storage, oxLDL response, foam cell differentiation and ABCA1/apoA-I-driven efflux and HDL assembly, without the reverse transport, HDL clearance and sterol homeostasis terms of its superset.

name: RUNX1-controlled megakaryocyte-erythroid fate balance and platelet formation
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte/erythroid differentiation and platelet morphogenesis plus RUNX1 regulation and negative control of erythroid differentiation, which the smaller theme lacks.

name: Megakaryocyte maturation, platelet shaping and terminal erythropoiesis
rationale: All members concern megakaryocyte development and differentiation control, platelet morphogenesis and TAL1-GFI1B/terminal erythroid programmes, lacking the RUNX1 and platelet-signalling members of its superset.

core: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic double-strand break recombination and synaptonemal complex assembly
rationale: All members concern programmed meiotic DSB formation and repair, recombination intermediate resolution, telomere-led pairing and synaptonemal complex formation; it lacks the checkpoint and strand invasion terms of its superset.

core: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and prophase I checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB recombination, strand invasion and synapsis in both sexes plus the meiotic checkpoint and negative regulation of meiotic division, which distinguish it from the smaller recombination theme.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
qualifier: peptide loading with lipid presentation, no NKT regulation
name: MHC class II peptide loading and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: All members concern MHC class II peptide processing/loading, CD1 lipid antigen presentation and associated TLR7/8 antigen-presentation modules; it lacks the NKT cell regulation terms of its superset.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC class II and CD1 presentation with NKT activation
rationale: Members cover MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation plus regulation of NKT cell activation, differentiation and proliferation, the lipid-antigen effector arm the smaller theme lacks.

core: MHC class II exogenous peptide antigen presentation
name: Regulation of MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover exogenous peptide loading onto MHC class II and its positive and negative regulation, which the minimal core theme lacks.

core: MHC class II exogenous peptide antigen presentation
name: Core MHC class II peptide loading and presentation
rationale: All five members describe the basic exogenous peptide processing and MHC class II loading machinery, without the regulatory terms of the larger theme.

qualifier: amyloid-beta production, tau tangles and lysosomal regulation
name: Microglia in amyloid-beta production, tau tangles and lysosomal regulation
rationale: Members cover microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance plus amyloid-beta formation, neurofibrillary tangle assembly, lysosome/glucosylceramide regulation, astrocyte and LTP effects, which the phagocytic-clearance themes lack.

core: Microglial amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Microglial proliferation, cytotoxicity and phagocytic amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: All members concern microglial proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and promotion of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance; it lacks the negative regulation of clearance and activation present in its near-twin.

core: Microglial amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Bidirectional regulation of microglial amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover microglial effector functions and amyloid-beta/apoptotic cell clearance with both positive and negative regulation of clearance and microglial activation, the brakes absent from its near-twin.

name: Microglial phosphatidylserine recognition and efferocytosis of apoptotic cells
rationale: All members concern microglial activation, DAP12 signalling and recognition/engulfment of phosphatidylserine-exposing apoptotic neurons and neutrophils; it lacks the astrocyte, glial proliferation and excitotoxic terms of its superset.

qualifier: broader glial response and excitotoxic injury
name: Glial activation, excitotoxic neuron death and apoptotic cell engulfment
rationale: Members cover microglial efferocytosis plus astrocyte activation, glial proliferation and apoptosis, kainic acid response and amyloid-beta formation, which the narrower microglial engulfment theme lacks.

qualifier: mtDNA replication through translation, no tRNA processing
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, mRNA turnover and translation
rationale: All members concern mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability and decay, mitoribosome assembly and translation; it lacks the tRNA processing and RNA import terms of its superset.

name: Mitochondrial gene expression with tRNA processing and RNA import
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA turnover and translation plus mitochondrial tRNA processing/modification, 3'-end processing, tRNA transport and RNA import, which distinguish it from the smaller theme.
